scope: The prior pinned 84-stamp host-Mesa frame and V8 SVG prototype, compared at 192x192 and 72 dpi with the same exporter and readers. Ablations change the SVG and are diagnostic, not native-parity candidates.

minimal_vector_mask.shape: black 2x2 rectangle at (40,40), objectBoundingBox radial alpha mask, center opacity 1 and edge 0

interpretation: The width mask materially changes the mismatch and a reduced vector-only mask exhibits strong size-dependent reader differences consistent with different shading sampling. This does not prove the internal reader algorithm or establish that all discrepancy comes from sampling. Per-stamp alpha-transfer filters are separately rasterized by the exporter; removing them does not eliminate the mismatch. A fixed pixel shift is not a scale-independent SVG/PDF conversion.
limitations: Retained prototype and native capture inputs are required; scripts and prior receipt document runner and Python dependencies.
Synthetic ablations are not native parity or production output.
No device, other readers, arbitrary scale, color, or saved-note claim.
